purpose: Assisted native BUG012/014 recheck using a real generated Rogue Soldier
status: Reviewed proposal, syntax checked; not executed in a native client by this agent
commands: lua_run local s=LOD.RunManager.State local v=GetConVar("lod_developer_mode") print("PT12_PRE",#player.GetHumans(),v and v:GetInt(),s.BuildReady,s.Failed,s.LevelCleared,s.SimulationFrozen,s.LevelSeed,not(s.Graph==nil))
lua_run local f=P12 f.eligible=function(e) local q=f.R:ProgressionState(e) return q and q.classId=="rogue" and e.LODArchetypeId=="soldier" and e.LODActivated and not e.LODDead and e:Health()>0 end
lua_run for _,e in ipairs(LOD.HostileRegistry:List()) do if P12.eligible(e) then P12.e=e break end end print("PT12_SOURCE",P12.e)
lua_run local f=P12 if IsValid(f.p) then f.b=f.T:Bind(f.p) f.home=f.p:GetPos() f.hc=f.T:CellAt(f.S.Graph,f.home) end print("PT12_HERO",not(f.b==nil),not(f.hc==nil))
lua_run local f=P12 if f.b and IsValid(f.e) then f.l=LOD.EnemyRoster:CaptureLife(f.e,f.p) f.q=f.l and f.l.sourceState end print("PT12_BIND",not(f.l==nil))

lua_run local f=P12 f.live=function() return P12==f and f.q and f.q.derivedStats and f.T:Matches(f.b) and LOD.EnemyRoster:ValidLife(f.l) and f.q.classId=="rogue" and f.q.derivedStats.rogueBackstabEnabled==true end
lua_run local f=P12 if f.live() then local q=f.l.sourceState print("PT12_CLASS",f.e:EntIndex(),q.actorId,q.classId,q.derivedStats.rogueBackstabEnabled) end
lua_run local f=P12 f.locate=function() f.d=nil f.c=f.T:CellAt(f.S.Graph,f.e:GetPos()) if f.c then f.v=LOD.MazeNavigator:CellCenter(f.c) end end
lua_run local f=P12 f.land=function(v) local d=f.T:Landing(f.p,f.S.Graph,f.c,v) return d and d:DistToSqr(f.e:GetPos())>16384 and not f.E:ProtectedPosition(d) and d end
lua_run local f=P12 f.pick=function() f.locate() if not f.c then return end for _,v in ipairs(f.O) do local d=f.land(f.v+v) if d then f.d=d break end end end
lua_run local f=P12 f.dot=function() local v=f.e:GetPos()-f.p:GetPos() v.z=0 local a=f.p:EyeAngles():Forward() a.z=0 return v:GetNormalized():Dot(a:GetNormalized()) end
lua_run local f=P12 f.ready=function() return f.live() and f.E:Claim(f.e)==f.p and f.E:CombatAllowed(f.p,f.e) and LOD.RPGStatusElements:CanInitiateAttack(f.e) and f.dot()<=-.5 end

lua_run local f=P12 f.fire=function() local ok=f.ready() print("PT12_GATES",ok) if ok then print("PT12_REAR",f.dot()) print("PT12_BURST",f.e:_BeginSoldierBurst(f.p),not(f.e.LODSoldierBurst==nil)) end end
lua_run local f=P12 f.back=function() if not(P12==f) then return end if f.T:Matches(f.b) then print("PT12_RETURN",f.T:MoveBound(f.b,f.home,nil,f.hc)) end P12=nil end

lua_run local f=P12 if f.live() then f.pick() print("PT12_D",f.d) if f.d and f.T:MoveBound(f.b,f.d,f.live,f.c) then f.p:SetEyeAngles((f.p:GetPos()-f.e:GetPos()):Angle()) timer.Simple(.3,f.fire) timer.Simple(8,f.back) print("PT12_MOVED") end end

stages.require: Fresh private profile, correct native phrase/CRC, exactly one human, developer mode1 for this explicitly assisted fixture, BuildReady true, Failed/LevelCleared/SimulationFrozen false, nonnil graph.

Ordinary Hero selection and portal deployment completed. A real existing live/activated Rogue Soldier is selected. Hero and home-cell bindings true, source-life binding true, actorId is generated monster identity, class Rogue and existing derived capability true. Stop and change setup if any condition fails.
Preparation only. No actor/class/health/protection changes; helpers capture exact fixture ownership and canonical Hero/source life/graph bindings.

Release ordinary movement/attack input, run final action and immediately hide console. SafeTeleport checks supported standing clearance at one of four160-unit offsets, outside sanctuary and128+ units from enemy. Actual EntrySafety Claim/CombatAllowed and attack-status eligibility are preserved. One normal burst attempt at0.3s, owner-bound home return/cleanup at8s.

expected_native_evidence: Record real source EntIndex, generated actorId, Rogue class and true existing capability.
PT12_MOVED, PT12_GATES true, PT12_REAR at most -0.5, then normal warning/bolts and actual Backstab notice naming Soldier.
Capture rendered notice and identical normal retained-history text with adjacent Soldier damage. A successful API call alone is not acceptance.
Native kill/death can additionally demonstrate BUG014 readable Hostile label. Cold phrase lookup alone is API evidence.
PT12_RETURN true if original Hero remains alive; death/role/life/graph replacement prevents moving its replacement. P12 is cleared after the8-second callback.
limits: Assisted relocation/attack fixture does not prove ordinary traversal, natural AI acquisition, complete Backstab cone/cache behavior or cooperative acceptance.

If no real eligible Rogue Soldier, no safe landing, entry admission or real hit exists, report the exact setup gap and choose a different setup. Do not force class, weaken protection, change health or inject presentation events.
Current burst may retain Backstab after turning because qualification is cached per target/attack. Use a fresh burst for a front-facing negative case.
If preparation fails before the final action, abort with lua_run P12=nil. Do not clear P12 during the active8-second window because it intentionally retires its ownership token.
